breakout.answer_line: Breakout (Atari-style brick breaker on the 8×8 grid).

pong.answer_line: Pong (single‑agent, left paddle; a simplified Pong/squash on the grid).

pacman.answer_line: A Pac-Man-style maze game. The agent navigates a fixed symmetric maze (corner L-walls plus a central block) collecting pellets while avoiding roaming ghosts.

freeway.answer_line: A road-crossing game in the style of Freeway (Atari 2600) or Frogger. The agent crosses lanes of horizontally moving traffic to reach a goal row at the top.
